step-1.text: Lay one side panel flat, holes facing up. Screw in four cam pins and tap in four wood dowels.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 4 cam pins and 4 wood dowels.

step-2.text: Slide the bottom panel onto the pins at the low end. Two cam locks go in, arrow toward the pin, then a firm clockwise turn.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 bottom panel and 2 cam locks.

step-3.text: The fixed shelf holds the bookcase square, so it goes in now. Slide onto the pins and lock with cam locks, clockwise.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 fixed shelf and 2 cam locks.

step-4.text: Pins and dowels go into the ends of the panels on this side too. With a helper, lower the second side onto all of them at once, then lock the last four cam locks.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 4 cam pins, 4 wood dowels and 4 cam locks.

step-5.text: Tap four dowels into the top edges of the sides. Set the top panel on, good side up, then lock it from inside with four cam locks.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 top panel, 4 wood dowels and 4 cam locks.

step-6.text: Tap four dowels into the ends of the plinth board and press it in under the bottom panel, at the front.

count-6.text: This step uses 1 plinth and 4 wood dowels.

step-7.text: Roll the bookcase over so it lies on its front. Ask your helper, and put the flattened box underneath to save the finish.

count-7.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-8.text: Lay the back panel on, smooth side facing in. Line it up with the bottom corners and nail it along the edges, about every twenty centimeters. If the corners line up, the bookcase is square.

step-9.text: Second back piece, butted tight against the first. Same nailing pattern along every edge.

step-10.text: Stand it up together. Lift with your legs, not your back.

count-10.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-11.text: Push twelve shelf pins into the holes at the heights you like, four per shelf, then rest each shelf on top. Move them any time.

count-11.text: This step uses 3 shelves and 12 shelf pins.

step-12.text: Fix the wall bracket to the back edge of the top, then into the wall with fixings made for your wall type. Tip-overs are real. Anchor it.

done.text: Done. Your ORION 20" narrow storage shelf is built. Give it a proud little pat.
